description.value: MRI study comparing regional gray matter volumes and densities between smokers and nonsmokers, including voxel-based morphometry and hand-drawn region-of-interest analyses.
Observational cross-sectional study of otherwise healthy adult smokers and nonsmoking control subjects recruited through local newspaper advertisements.

name.value: main effect of pack-year smoking history on regional gray matter density

spans.text: For the VBM analysis of main effect of pack-year smoking history on regional gray matter density, the left ( Z = 5.38, x, y, z = −54, 14, 26, p < .0005, 300 voxels) and right ( Z = 6.06, x, y, z = 42, 14, 44, p < .0005, 371 voxels) prefrontal cortices had clusters of voxels with negative main effects of pack-year smoking history (according to the above significance criteria), indicating that greater pack-year smoking history was associated with lower gray matter densities in these regions.
